title: Timer-Based Actions with ElapsedTime

hints.title: Creating and starting the timer
hints.content: `new ElapsedTime()` starts the timer immediately. You don't need to call reset() unless you want to restart it mid-run.

hints.title: The while loop condition
hints.content: Combine two conditions with `&&`: `while (opModeIsActive() && timer.seconds() < 2.0)`. The `opModeIsActive()` check ensures the robot stops immediately if the Driver Station sends a stop command.

hints.title: Don't forget to stop the motors
hints.content: After the while loop exits, the motors still have power set. Add `leftMotor.setPower(0.0); rightMotor.setPower(0.0);` after the loop.
